hypothesis: A crafted FC 23 (WRITE_AND_READ_REGISTERS) request can make mapping_address_write negative while still passing the bounds test, because the write-start check repeats mapping_address < 0 instead of mapping_address_write < 0. The subsequent store then indexes tab_registers with a negative i.
evidence_source: The else-if at lines 962-965 is `mapping_address < 0 || (mapping_address + nb) > nb_registers || mapping_address < 0 || (mapping_address_write + nb_write) > nb_registers`. When mapping_address_write < 0 but mapping_address_write + nb_write <= nb_registers (and the read range is valid), control reaches the loop at 978-981: `mb_mapping->tab_registers[i] = ...` with i starting at mapping_address_write.
